notched_longsword.name: Notched Longsword
notched_longsword.description: A soldier's longsword with more notches in the edge than you can account for. You remember some of them.

battered_shield.name: Battered Shield
battered_shield.description: Oak and iron, the paint long gone. Someone carved a small sun into the back of the grip.

dented_mail.name: Dented Mail
dented_mail.description: A shirt of riveted rings, heavy and honest. It smells of rust and other people's sweat.

paired_knives.name: Paired Knives
paired_knives.description: Two slim knives, perfectly balanced, one slightly longer than the other. You named them once. You've forgotten the names.

smoke_grey_leathers.name: Smoke-Grey Leathers
smoke_grey_leathers.description: Supple leather dyed the colour of chimney smoke. It makes no noise at all when you move.

lockpicks.name: Lockpicks
lockpicks.description: A roll of thin steel picks. Technically illegal in three of Vael's four provinces.

cinderwood_staff.name: Cinderwood Staff
cinderwood_staff.description: A staff of wood that was struck by lightning and never quite stopped burning. It is warm to the touch, always.

singed_robes.name: Singed Robes
singed_robes.description: Scholar's robes, scorched at the cuffs from years of experiments that mostly worked.

pilgrims_mace.name: Pilgrim's Mace
pilgrims_mace.description: A flanged mace with a sunburst head. The pilgrim's creed is stamped into the haft: WALK TOWARD THE LIGHT.

lantern_of_vigil.name: Lantern of Vigil
lantern_of_vigil.description: A small brass lantern on a chain. Its flame burns a little brighter when you pray, and a little dimmer when you lie.

pilgrim_vestments.name: Pilgrim Vestments
pilgrim_vestments.description: Undyed wool, a yellow sash, a hood against the ash. Patched in a dozen places by a dozen different hands.

tin_sun_charm.name: Tin Sun Charm
tin_sun_charm.description: A cheap tin sunburst on a leather thong, the kind sold at every crossroads shrine. Blackened by the pyre, but whole.
